### Setting up Populations

Below are some parameters for setting up the populations.

```{r}
set.seed(123)
n_indv <- 45
n_loci <- 15
n_pop <- 3
n_rsloci <- 5

```

### Defining Reference Populations

There will be five generated populations each with unique allele frequencies defined by me.

```{r}
#Population 1
p_1 <- 0.6
q_1 <- 1 - p_1
Pop_1 <- data.frame(matrix(sample(c("AA", "Aa", "aa"), size = n_indv * n_loci, replace = TRUE,prob = c(p_1^2, 2 * p_1 * q_1, q_1^2)),nrow = n_indv,ncol = n_loci))
rownames(Pop_1) <- paste0("Indv_A.", 1:n_indv)
colnames(Pop_1) <- paste0("Genotype_Locus", 1:n_loci)


#Population 2
p_2 <- 0.2
q_2 <- 1 - p_2

Pop_2 <- data.frame(matrix(sample(c("AA", "Aa", "aa"), size = n_indv * n_loci, replace = TRUE,prob = c(p_2^2, 2 * p_2 * q_2, q_2^2)),nrow = n_indv,ncol = n_loci))
rownames(Pop_2) <- paste0("Indv_B.", 1:n_indv)
colnames(Pop_2) <- paste0("Genotype_Locus", 1:n_loci)

#Population 3
p_3 <- 0.9
q_3 <- 1 - p_3
Pop_3 <- data.frame(matrix(sample(c("AA", "Aa", "aa"), size = n_indv * n_loci, replace = TRUE,prob = c(p_3^2, 2 * p_3 * q_3, q_3^2)),nrow = n_indv,ncol = n_loci))
rownames(Pop_3) <- paste0("Indv_C.", 1:n_indv)
colnames(Pop_3) <- paste0("Genotype_Locus", 1:n_loci)

#Population 4
p_4 <- 0.5
q_4 <- 1 - p_4
Pop_4 <- data.frame(matrix(sample(c("AA", "Aa", "aa"), size = n_indv * n_loci, replace = TRUE,prob = c(p_4^2, 2 * p_4 * q_4, q_4^2)),nrow = n_indv,ncol = n_loci))
rownames(Pop_4) <- paste0("Indv_D.", 1:n_indv)
colnames(Pop_4) <- paste0("Genotype_Locus", 1:n_loci)

#Population 5
p_5 <- 0.7
q_5 <- 1 - p_5
Pop_5 <- data.frame(matrix(sample(c("AA", "Aa", "aa"), size = n_indv * n_loci, replace = TRUE,prob = c(p_5^2, 2 * p_5 * q_5, q_5^2)),nrow = n_indv,ncol = n_loci))
rownames(Pop_5) <- paste0("Indv_E", 1:n_indv)
colnames(Pop_5) <- paste0("Genotype_Locus", 1:n_loci)

head(Pop_1)
head(Pop_2)
head(Pop_3)
head(Pop_4)
head(Pop_5)
```

### Randomized Sampling

Although I will be working with this generated data for future modules, I want to base each individual modules on randomly selected loci. I also selected 3 random populations to work with for this module.

```{r}

sample(Pop_3, 1)
sample(n_pop,3)

sample(n_loci, 3)
```

### Defining Deviated Populations

These are generated populations each with unique allele frequencies defined by me to simulate deviations from HWE, such as habitat fragmentation, genetic migration and inbreeding.

```{r}


#Population 6: Mirrors Population 1 but shows consequences of inbreeding after x generations

n.sindv <-10
n_sloci <-3
p_6 <- 0.6 
q_6 <- 1 - p_6 
Pop_6 <- data.frame(matrix(sample(c("AA", "Aa", "aa"), size = n.sindv * n_sloci, replace = TRUE,prob = c(p_6^2, 2 * p_6 * q_6, q_6^2)),nrow = n.sindv, ncol = n_sloci)) 
rownames(Pop_6) <- paste0("Indv_A.", 1:n.sindv)

Pop_6
```

###  Genotype Counts and Frequencies

Genotype counts are bound per population at the sampled locus. The same formula is used for defining and binding each population's genotype frequencies.

```{r}
#Binding genotype counts per (original) population

#Testing locus 5 at populations 1, 2, 3 

gc_locus5 <- rbind(table(Pop_1$Genotype_Locus5), table(Pop_2$Genotype_Locus5), table(Pop_3$Genotype_Locus5))
rownames(gc_locus5) <- c("Pop_1", "Pop_2", "Pop_3")

#Checking table

gc_locus5
```

```{r}

#Defining frequencies for Locus 5

fq_locus5 <- gc_locus5 / sum(gc_locus5)
fq_locus5 <- round(fq_locus5, digits = 3)
rownames(fq_locus5) <- c("Pop_1", "Pop_2", "Pop_3")

fq_locus5


```

### Calculating Heterozygosity and Homozygosity

```{r}
#Homozygosity & Heterozygosity percentages

#Locus 5
HMP1L5 <- sum(gc_locus5[1,1] + gc_locus5[1,3]) / sum(gc_locus5[2,]) * 100
HTP1L5 <- 100 - HMP1L5
HMP1L5
HTP1L5
Pop1_HTHM <- cbind(HTP1L5, HMP1L5)
Pop1_HTHM

HMP2L5 <- sum(gc_locus5[2,1] + gc_locus5[2,3]) / sum(gc_locus5[3,]) * 100
HTP2L5 <- 100 - HMP2L5
HMP2L5
HTP2L5

HMP3L5<- sum(gc_locus5[3,1] + gc_locus5[3,3]) / sum(gc_locus5[3,]) * 100
HTP3L5 <- 100 - HMP3L5
HTP3L5
HMP3L5


P_HTL5 <- c(HTP1L5, HTP2L5, HTP3L5)
P_HTL5 <- round(P_HTL5, digits = 3)


P_HML5 <- c(HMP1L5, HMP2L5, HMP3L5)
P_HML5 <- round(P_HML5, digits = 3)

P_HTL5
P_HML5


RBHHL5 <- rbind(P_HML5, P_HTL5)
RBHHL5.1 <- cbind(P_HTL5, P_HML5)


colnames(RBHHL5) <- c("Pop_1", "Pop_2", "Pop_3")
rownames(RBHHL5) <- c("Homozygosity % ", "Heterozygosity %")
RBHHL5
RBHHL5.1
```

### Expected and Observed allele freq

```{r}
#Observed allele frequencies at each sampled population: L11

O_P2L11 <- c(p2o =  2 * (fq_locus11[1,2] + fq_locus11[1,3]) / (2 * n_indv))
O_P2L11 <- round(O_P2L11, digits = 3)
O_P2L11
O_Q2L11 <-c( 1 - O_P2L11 )
O_Q2L11 <- round(O_Q2L11, digits = 3)
O_Q2L11

O_P3L11 <- c(p3o =  2 * (fq_locus11[2,2] + fq_locus11[2,3]) / (2 * n_indv))
O_P3L11 <- round(O_P3L11, digits = 3)
O_P3L11
O_Q3L11 <-c( 1 - O_P3L11 )
O_Q3L11 <- round(O_Q3L11, digits = 3)
O_Q3L11

O_P4L11 <- c(p2o =  2 * (fq_locus11[3,2] + fq_locus11[3,3]) / (2 * n_indv))
O_P4L11 <- round(O_P4L11, digits = 3)
O_P4L11
O_Q4L11 <-c( 1 - O_P4L11 )
O_Q4L11 <- round(O_Q4L11, digits = 3)
O_Q4L11

AOPFL11 <- cbind(O_P2L11, O_P3L11, O_P4L11)
AOQFL11 <- cbind(O_Q2L11, O_Q3L11, O_Q4L11)

AOAFL11 <- rbind(AOPFL11, AOQFL11)
colnames(AOAFL11) <- c("Population 2", "Population 3", "Population 4")
rownames(AOAFL11) <- c("P Frequency", "Q Frequency")
AOAFL11

#Expected allele frequencies
E_P2L11 <- c(p =  (2 * p_2 * q_2) / (2 * n_indv))
E_P2L11 <- round(E_P2L11, digits = 3)
E_P2L11
E_Q2L11 <- c( 1 - E_P2L11)
E_Q2L11 <- round(E_Q2L11, digits = 3)
E_Q2L11

E_P3L11 <- c(p =  (2 * p_3 * q_3) / (2 * n_indv))
E_P3L11 <- round(E_P3L11, digits = 3)
E_P3L11
E_Q3L11 <- c( 1 - E_P3L11)
E_Q3L11 <- round(E_Q3L11, digits = 3)
E_Q3L11

E_P4L11 <- c(p =  (2 * p_4 * q_4) / (2 * n_indv))
E_P4L11 <- round(E_P4L11, digits = 3)
E_P4L11
E_Q4L11 <- c( 1 - E_P4L11)
E_Q4L11 <- round(E_Q4L11, digits = 3)
E_Q4L11


AEPFL11 <- cbind(E_P2L11, E_P3L11, E_P4L11)
AEQFL11 <- cbind(E_Q2L11, E_Q3L11, E_Q4L11)

AEAFL11 <- rbind(AEPFL11, AEQFL11)
colnames(AEAFL11) <- c("Population 2", "Population 3", "Population 4")
rownames(AEAFL11) <- c("P Frequency", "Q Frequency")
AEAFL11
```

### Expected and Observed Heterozygosity

Below I calculated expected and observed heterozygosity between each population at locus one. Observed data based on the averages from generated population and expected data based on originally set allele frequency values.

```{r}
#Expected at each population for Locus 11

EHZP1L5 <- c(Aa =  2 * p_1 * q_1)
EHZP1L5 

EHZP2L5 <- c(Aa =  2 * p_2 * q_2)
EHZP2L5 

EHZP3L5 <- c(Aa =  2 * p_3 * q_3)
EHZP3L5 

AEHZL5 <- rbind(EHZP1L5, EHZP2L5, EHZP3L5)

AEHZL5


#Observed
OHZP1L5 <- c(Aa =  fq_locus5[1,2])
OHZP1L5 

OHZP2L5 <- c(Aa =  fq_locus5[2,2])
OHZP2L5 

OHZP3L5 <- c(Aa =  fq_locus5[3,2])
OHZP3L5 

AOHZL5 <- rbind(OHZP1L5, OHZP2L5, OHZP3L5)

AOHZL5
```

# Figures

### Genotype Counts

```{r}
#Grouped Graphs for Genotype Counts
par(mfrow = c(1,2))

ylimgc <- c(0, 40)
gc_locus5R <- round(gc_locus5, digits = 2)

SPGCL5 <- barplot(gc_locus5, col=colors()[c(36, 12, 55)], border = "white", font.axis = 1, beside = T, xlab="Genotype Count", font.lab=1, ylim = ylimgc)
colnames(SPGCL5) <- c("aa", "Aa", "AA")
text(x = SPGCL5, y = gc_locus5, labels = gc_locus5R, adj = c(.5, -0.75), cex = .5, col = "black")

plot.new()
legend("center", legend = c("Pop1", "Pop2", "Pop3"), col = colors()[c(36, 12, 55)], lty = 1, bty = "n")
```

### Genotype Frequencies

```{r}
#Grouped Graphs for Genotype Frequencies
par(mfrow = c(1,2))

ylimfq <- c(0, 0.3)
fq_locus5R <- round(fq_locus5, digits = 2)

SPGFL5 <- barplot(fq_locus5, col=colors()[c(36, 12, 55)], border = "white", font.axis = 1, beside = T, xlab="Label", main = "Locus 5 Genotype Frequencies", font.lab=1, ylim = ylimfq)

```
